Principles Executing well integrated projects serving the community Implementing visions through creative concepts and ideas Delivering high quality controlled projects Improving continuously our capabilities and techniques Creating well coordinated spaces satisfying the envisioned purpose
Key Figures 2 international offices 16 different countries 30+ years of Experience 300+ Employees 800+ Projects delivered ISO 9001: 2015 certification
Our Milestones 1989 — Established in Cairo 1993 — 1st Major National Project Greater Cairo Metro 1996 — 1st International Projects in Asia & Africa 2002 — Sogreah Middle East Partnership 2009 — 1st Prize International Competition for Ramses Square 2011 — Saudi Market Entrance 2013 — Mega Project Half Moon Bay in KSA 2016 — Mega Project with National Authority of Tunnels 2017 — Mega Project Électricité de France 2020 — World's Largest Textite Weaving and Dyeing Factory 2023 — World Bank Upper Egypt Local Development 2025 — Establishment of Second KSA Office in Jeddah
